reels.title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper directly addresses the 'memory' constraint in world models, which is a high-fascination topic. Its 'constant-size' approach provides a perfect visual narrative for 3b1b-style animations showing a growing vs. fixed-size buffer.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How do AI models watch long videos without running out of 'brain space'?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A painter who creates a long mural but only has a single fixed-size canvas to hold the entire story.
